maya (PM): Two quick UX decisions from today's review: where should the primary CTA live for autoscale edits — inline card or only in expanded panel?
ravi (product-designer): Leaning expanded panel footer. Keeps the card tidy and reduces accidental saves. Card shows an 'Edit' affordance.
tal (frontend): Agreed. Card-level quick toggles OK for read-only changes (e.g., switch pool), but any cost-affecting change (burst, min/max) should require opening panel and hitting Save.
liam (eng-run): Backend will accept a single 'apply_changes' action. We can surface a preview of estimated cost but only commit on Save.
ana (a11y): Important: Save must be reachable by keyboard as a prominent button. When panel opens, focus should go to first input and stay in panel until closed. Use aria-modal or dialog semantics.
ravi (product-designer): Burst pattern idea: compact pill on card reading 'Burst: Off' that expands inline to a small drawer with slider + CTA 'Enable burst (approx. +$X/hr)'. Makes discovery low-friction.
tal (frontend): Implement as an inline drawer, not a separate modal. Drawer should trap focus and return focus to pill on cancel. We'll make the cost text read: 'Approx. +$X/hr (varies with traffic)'.
liam (eng-run): We'll provide a client-side estimate input (recent QPS sample) and a flag to indicate 'inexact estimate'. UI should show 'Approx.' to be safe.
ana (a11y): Ensure the 'approx' phrase and estimation basis are visible in DOM text, not only in a tooltip. Also avoid 'ephemeral' — use 'temporary instances'.
ravi (product-designer): Min/max labels: change to 'Min instances' / 'Max instances' and add microcopy: 'Each instance = N GPUs'. Also show computed 'Total GPUs' below.
atal (typo) 
maya (PM): haha ignore the last line. One more: pool dropdown sort: default to 'Recommended' but allow toggling to 'Cheapest' or 'Most used' via small chips in the dropdown header.
tal (frontend): Will build a custom combobox for that. Need to test VoiceOver/TalkBack on staging.
deploy-bot: Preview deploy queued: preview/autoscale-cta-drawer -> staging. Build #9254.
maya (PM): Thanks team — tag any copy/accessibility nits on the staging preview.
